newsitem.title: FRANCE: Alcatel boosted by Fidelity stake.
newsitem.headline: Alcatel boosted by Fidelity stake.

text.p: Shares in Alcatel Alsthom were boosted on Thursday by news that U.S. fund Fidelity had increased its stake to over 10 percent.
At 1004 GMT, Alcatel shares were up 1.54 percent at 791 francs in a volume of 245,332 shares.
The investment group told the Bourse authorities on Wednesday evening it now holds 10.4 percent in Alcatel and is its biggest investor.
Financial analysts said that the confidence shown by Fidelity in Alcatel's recovery was attracting other investors to the stock.
"Compared to Ericsson, Alcatel is not that expensive. For Fidelity, which is a long-term investor, telecoms are a sector of the future," an analyst said.
Alcatel was also helped by two big contracts, one in South Africa on Wednesday and a 1.2 billion franc fibre-optic subsea cable announced today.
